query: SELECT SUM(pdi.producao) as total_producao FROM parte_diaria_itens pdi JOIN parte_diaria pd ON pdi.parteDiariaId = pd.id WHERE pdi.servicoId IN (15, 24, 29, 46) AND pd.data >= '2026-04-01' AND pd.data <= '2026-04-30';
